description: This file implements a WebSocket protocol wrapper for Twisted, supporting multiple WebSocket versions and handling handshake, framing, and connection management.

classes.name: WSException
classes.description: Custom exception class for WebSocket errors.

classes.name: WebSocketProtocol
classes.description: A protocol wrapper that implements WebSocket handshake, framing, and message handling for Twisted.

classes.name: WebSocketFactory
classes.description: A factory that wraps other protocols to provide WebSocket transport capabilities.

methods.name: http_headers
methods.description: Parses raw HTTP headers into a dictionary.

methods.name: is_websocket
methods.description: Determines if headers request a WebSocket upgrade.

methods.name: is_hybi00
methods.description: Checks if headers indicate HyBi-00 WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: make_accept
methods.description: Creates an accept key for WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: parse_hybi00_frames
methods.description: Parses HyBi-00 frames from a buffer.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Applies masking/unmasking to data with a key.

methods.name: make_hybi07_frame_dwim
methods.description: Creates a HyBi-07 frame with automatic binary/text detection.

methods.name: parse_hybi07_frames
methods.description: Parses HyBi-07 frames from a buffer.
